On the immediately following round the stub compiler MUST, IN ADDITION to any Kelvin stubs required by Rules 19/21/22/23/25, emit at least N_non_kelvin stubs targeting nets that appear in the board's unconnected-ratlines list and are NOT Kelvin-class nets. These non-Kelvin surplus stubs MUST be forwarded to FR without removal by the Rule 22/23 stale-targeting correction, because they target nets verified unrouted by the unconnected metric rather than stale compiler priorities. If the specific identity of the non-Kelvin unconnected net(s) cannot be determined from failing_reasons alone (failing_reasons only surfaces gate-triggering nets), the manager MUST escalate with log 'non_kelvin_unconnected_identity_unknown', reporting N_non_kelvin and the compiler's current candidate list, and halt FR dispatch for that round pending an explicit unconnected-ratlines query on the current board state. If N_non_kelvin > 0 persists for 3 consecutive rounds with non-Kelvin surplus stubs active, escalate as 'persistent_non_kelvin_unconnected' for routing geometry inspection. This rule is additive to Rules 19, 22, 23, 25, and 27 and does not replace or defer any halt those rules would independently impose.
